summary: Add babysit --watch guards for required checks before green, two-read CI settle, and REST fallback when GraphQL is rate-limited (#1233).
migration_impact: No config changes. Watch loops may report CI as pending slightly longer while checks settle; babysit uses REST when GraphQL primary rate limit is exhausted.
migration_guidance: Upgrade plate-core when this release ships.
No action required unless you rely on immediate single-tick CI success signaling in custom watch automation.
agent_notes: Watcher guard ideas adapted from t3dotgg/tstack pr-wait (MIT, copyright Theo Browne); PLATE implementation is original. Guards 3 (base moved into PR files) and 4 (restart-safe events) remain for a follow-up slice.
